title: Qin
subtitle: Independent
description: A Twi'lek criminal, Qin was taken prisoner by the New Republic. He used to run jobs with the Mandalorian, Din Djarin, back in the day and found himself rescued from a prison transport by Djarin and a crew that included Xi'an, Burg, and Migs Mayfeld. At Qin's behest, they decided to betray the Mandalorian. Mando turned the tables on them and escaped the transport, leaving them all imprisoned.
